# musicwire

musicwire renders MusicXML into music people can hear, edit, and verify. Start with the public documentation:

- https://musicwire.5432wire.com/docs - agent-first quickstart and worked examples
- https://musicwire.5432wire.com/manifest - machine-readable service capabilities and live prices
- https://musicwire.5432wire.com/.well-known/x402 - machine-readable payment discovery

Core workflow: connect through the musicwire MCP server or use HTTPS, submit complete MusicXML with MP3 for listening and MIDI for editing, authorize the quoted x402 payment, poll the returned job, then open the MP3 link and save the MIDI and receipt artifacts. These are the only requestable render outputs.
